notes.title: Patch 1.3.0
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

- Start menu has been redesigned so as to give players freedom when choosing game difficulty
- Each successful playthrough will unlock a new difficulty level
- [i]New game[/i] menu option will let players start a new journey in whatever difficulty they have unlocked. Bear in mind that starting a new game will clear their current progress entirely.

Good luck ;)

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Bugfix:[/b]

- Fixed a bug where sometimes players would not see the [i]new game+[/i] menu option.
- Fallen Bishop Barthiel's melee damage will now correctly scale with difficulty cycle.

notes.title: New content patch 1.1.0 : New Game+
notes.content:
[b]Patch content:[/b]

[list]
[*] Runemancers who have finished the game in normal mode will have the option to start a new journey on NG+
[*] NG+ waves get increasingly more difficult: enemies will have more health and overal damage, as well as greater resistance to damage
[*] A new achievement is rewarded upon finishing the first NG+ cycle 
[*] A new NG+ cycle can be started after the previous one is finished. How far can you go?
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed amulets tooltip so they reflect the two second duration bonus they grant.
[*] Made confirmation button on upgrade overlay easier to click on.
[/list]
